description:
Holder is a private offline vault for storing important card details securely on your Mac.

Use it to keep credit cards, debit cards, ID cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and other card information organized in one simple place.

Holder is built for people who want quick access to card details without storing sensitive information in notes, screenshots, messages, or random documents.

Your cards stay private, easy to find, and protected with Touch ID or your Mac login password when the vault lock is enabled.

Why Holder?

Private storage with optional sync
Holder is designed to work offline. Card details are stored in Apple Keychain and can sync across your Apple devices through iCloud Keychain when available. Optional card images may be stored in iCloud Documents. You do not need to link a bank account or depend on an online wallet account.

Protected by Apple Keychain
Card details are stored using Apple Keychain, the secure storage system built into Apple platforms for sensitive information.

Lock your vault
Use Touch ID or your Mac login password to open Holder when the vault lock is enabled.

Quick access when needed
Find saved card details faster when shopping online, booking travel, filling forms, managing subscriptions, or checking card information.

More than payment cards
Holder can store credit cards, debit cards, ID cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, insurance cards, and other cards you want to keep organized.

Simple by design
No bank linking. No finance dashboard. No spending analysis. Just a clean, private card keeper for the information you actually need.

Useful for:

- Credit and debit card storage
- Offline card access
- Secure card management
- ID card organization
- Membership and loyalty cards
- Travel card backup
- Private card storage
- Quick access to saved card details

Holder gives you a simple, secure way to keep important card information organized, private, and ready when you need it.
promotionalText: Keep credit cards, IDs, memberships, and loyalty cards organized on your Mac. Use the menu bar for quick access and lock Holder with Touch ID or your login password.
whatsNew: Fixed pauses that could happen during text animations when expanding a card in the menu bar or moving through the welcome screens.
